requirements.text: Put a frog in the toilet
requirements.source_phrase: Put a frog in the toilet

outcomes.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.
outcomes.target: A frog is visibly placed within the toilet bowl.
outcomes.reference: The toilet in the input image.

nodes.question: Does the edited image show a frog placed within the toilet bowl, and does comparison with the source establish that this is a requested change?
nodes.criteria: Pass if comparison with the source shows a frog visibly placed within the toilet bowl in the edited image. Fail if the bowl is assessable and no frog is placed within it. Unknown if the bowl or the relevant placement cannot be assessed reliably. This establishes the requested placement, not by itself whether the overall edit is complete.
nodes.binding: Compare the source and edited images, assessing the frog's position relative to the bowl interior. Do not treat frogs elsewhere as satisfying this placement check.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is there clear evidence of other conspicuous frog placements outside the toilet bowl that bears on whether the requested edit is fully realized?
nodes.criteria: Pass if the edited image clearly shows one or more conspicuous added frogs outside the bowl, such as on the raised lid/tank area or floor. Fail if the relevant visible areas are assessable and no such additional placements are present. Unknown if those areas or the comparison cannot be assessed reliably. This is evidence about the overall edit, not a requirement that extra frogs must be absent.
nodes.binding: Use the source and edited images to identify added frogs outside the bowl; distinguish visible evidence from uncertainty. Do not infer their presence or absence from s1.

nodes.question: Is a frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl?
nodes.criteria: For R1, complete when s1 passes and s2 does not establish conspicuous additional frog placements that make the overall edit visibly mixed. Partial when s1 passes and s2 passes, showing the requested bowl placement alongside conspicuous added frogs elsewhere. If s1 fails, absent only when s2 also fails and there is no other evidenced progress toward the requested placement; otherwise partial only when support evidence establishes such progress, and unknown when necessary evidence is unresolved. Do not treat unrelated edits as progress or infer visual facts not recorded by the supports.
nodes.binding: Target: A frog is visibly placed within the toilet bowl.. Reference: The toilet in the input image..

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.

This leaves the case of no bowl placement but conspicuous added frogs unresolved, despite the rubric requiring unrelated edits not to count as progress and no progress to be no. The composition therefore lacks a determinate outcome for an applicable evidence combination."}
